translations.web: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
translations.bsb: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
translations.kjv: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
translations.asv: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.
